I can't see the bank draft, so I can't confirm the 2026 regulations or CBI Q&A 1012 (April 2025) it cites. Please check the CBI website or share the text before relying on them. My general understanding of the framework:

- **Transparency-policy disclosures:** The prospectus and KID should describe the fund's holdings-disclosure policy, including frequency, timing and who receives the information.
- **Daily public holdings:** Standard UCITS ETFs publish their full portfolio daily, alongside an indicative NAV (iNAV), so market makers can price and hedge.
- **Conditional periodic-holdings route:** A fund (typically actively managed or semi-transparent) may disclose holdings less often than daily. In that case it generally must give authorised participants and market makers alternative daily information, such as a basket or proxy portfolio and an iNAV, so that arbitrage still works. The exact conditions should be checked against the cited guidance.
